description: Recorded LLM output for offline fallback. Extracts rule candidates from the Chief Engineer onboarding transcript using schema-constrained scribe.

rule_candidates.title: No re-energisation without LEW sign-off
allowed_actions: Deploy drip trays and cordon area
forbidden_actions: Entering electrical cupboard before LEW confirms safe
Operating any wet breaker or switch

exceptions.note: LEW confirms affected section is spare/dead board

rule_candidates.threshold_note: 2 m proximity threshold is expert professional judgement, not a code requirement. Code says 'near electrical equipment' without defining distance.

rule_candidates.title: Isolate chilled-water source at nearest accessible valve within 10 minutes
rule_candidates.decision: Isolate at nearest local sub-valve; if source is riser pipe or sub-valve inaccessible, isolate riser; if condensate, isolate at AHU unit level
allowed_actions: Close floor or riser valve if branch valve inaccessible
Close domestic water main for stack (Duty Manager informed)
forbidden_actions: Closing fire-protection valves without FSM authorisation
Re-energising AHU circuit before LEW sign-off if water near electrical

exceptions.note: Condensate — isolate at AHU unit level, do not isolate riser

rule_candidates.distinguishing_condition: Leak on branch with working sub-valve → isolate branch only. Leak on riser pipe or inaccessible sub-valve → isolate riser. Condensate → isolate at AHU unit, never riser.

rule_candidates.title: Tenant-area isolation within 15 minutes; first-notice message within 30 min
rule_candidates.decision: Draft first-notice tenant message within 30 min of tenant call; isolate source within 15 min to prevent business interruption
forbidden_actions: Re-energising before LEW sign-off if water near electrical

exceptions.note: DC overlay: tenant message replaced by client-SLA notification (15 min SLA)
